time_basis: committed semantic microsteps and per-hop transport ticks; not a physical latency measurement
router_boundary: ChiStoreForwardRouterNode is presented as an XP abstraction with finite ingress, exact NodeID route, egress, and Link Credit; not a complete XP microarchitecture or cycle-latency model

four-by-four-mesh.shape: four-by-four bidirectional mesh with corner endpoints

topology_projection: nodes and directed connections are validated against the executed SystemProtocol; paired directed hops are folded into a physical-edge backdrop, then the actual REQ/DAT routes are overlaid
presentation_boundary: model-level topology, exact routes, transaction lineage, and quiescence; no raw pin waveform or RTL cycle spacing
model_boundary: restricted ReadNoSnp/CompData over REQ/DAT; mesh size and route-table closure do not imply broader opcode or traffic-pattern coverage; no shared-bus arbitration, RSP/SNP coherence, adaptive routing, complete CHI, performance, QoS/fairness, or deadlock proof
